name: wash_sale_harvest_carryforward
question_template: A fictional robo-advisor holds {N} shares of ETF Q bought at {B0} USD each and sells them all at {P1} USD each. {D} days later it buys {R} shares of the same ETF at {P2} USD each. Wash-sale rule: if the first sale was a loss and the repurchase is within 30 days (inclusive), the per-share loss times the smaller of shares sold and repurchased is disallowed and added to the new lot's total basis; a first-sale gain is unaffected. Later the same tax year the whole new lot is sold at {P3} USD each with no further repurchase; nothing else is realized. The net result is the allowed signed first-sale result plus the signed second-sale result. If the net is a loss, at most {C} USD is deductible this year and the excess carries forward; if a gain, deduction and carryforward are zero. What loss in USD carries forward?

slots.description: Loss on the first sale disallowed by the wash-sale rule, USD
Total cost basis of the repurchased lot after adding disallowed loss, USD
Signed net realized result for the year, positive means gain, USD
Net loss deductible this year after the annual cap, USD

program:
def solve():
    N = P["N"]
    B0 = P["B0"]
    P1 = P["P1"]
    D = P["D"]
    R = P["R"]
    P2 = P["P2"]
    P3 = P["P3"]
    C = P["C"]
    if N <= 0 or R <= 0 or C < 0:
        raise ValueError("share counts must be positive and cap non-negative")
    first_signed = N * (P1 - B0)
    per_share_loss = B0 - P1
    if per_share_loss > 0 and D <= 30:
        matched = N if N < R else R
        disallowed = per_share_loss * matched
    else:
        disallowed = 0
    allowed_first = first_signed + disallowed
    basis2 = R * P2 + disallowed
    second_signed = R * P3 - basis2
    net = allowed_first + second_signed
    if net < 0:
        loss = -net
        deduction = loss if loss < C else C
        carry = loss - deduction
    else:
        deduction = 0
        carry = 0
    return {
        "final": carry,
        "disallowed_loss": disallowed,
        "adjusted_lot_basis": basis2,
        "net_result": net,
        "year_deduction": deduction
    }
